build_interface_config: build an InterfaceConfig to place adsorbates, solvent, and ions on a slab surface using packmol
create_interface_on_sites: create a solvent and ion interface on top of adsorbate-slab configurations with overlap checking
create_packmol_atoms: create packed solvent and ion atoms in a unit cell volume using packmol input files
run_packmol: run the packmol executable with an input file to pack molecules in a defined geometry
randomize_coords: randomize atom coordinates within a unit cell by setting center of mass to a random position
